name: Cash Deposit Or Withdrawal Status Update V 01
definition: The CashDepositOrWithdrawalStatusUpdate message reports the status of a cash deposit request or cash withdrawal request.|Where reporting on the status of a cash deposit request, it is sent by a cash receiver to a cash sender.|Where reporting on the status of a cash withdrawal request, it is sent by a cash sender to a cash receiver.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual notifications included in the message.

RequestInformationAndStatus.name: Request Information And Status
RequestInformationAndStatus.definition: Information concerning the original request, to which the status report message refers.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information incorporated as an extension to the message.
